examples.name: H563 LED blink (PA5, CN7 pin 10)
examples.description: SysTick firmware toggles PA5 every 100 ms; 330 Ω and a red LED to ground. LED brightness follows the solved current.

examples.name: H563 RC button to EXTI (PA6, CN9 pin 1)
examples.description: Hold the push button: a 10 kΩ/100 kΩ divider charges 100 nF on PA6; each Schmitt crossing interrupts the firmware, which mirrors PA6 onto the PA5 LED.

examples.name: DC divider
examples.description: Analog only: 5 V across 2 kΩ + 3 kΩ; the midpoint must read 3 V.

examples.name: RC charge through a switch
examples.description: Analog only: hold the button to charge 10 µF through 1 kΩ (τ = 10 ms); release and it holds its charge.

examples.name: NPN low-side LED switch
examples.description: Analog only: the button drives 10 kΩ into a 2N3904-like base; the transistor saturates and sinks the LED current through 220 Ω.
